title: The Role of Laryngopharyngeal Reflux in IPF
official: The Role of Laryngopharyngeal Reflux in IPF
summary: The primary objective of this study is to show that the Supraglottic Index (SGI) is an easily-collected index that accurately identifies the presence and severity of laryngopharyngeal reflux (LPF) in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF).
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of IPF
* Age 40-95
* Able to read, speak, and understand English
* If subjects are currently taking medication for reflux or GERD, they much be on a stable does for at least 4 weeks prior to consent.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients who do not meet all inclusion criteria
* Pregnant females
